1.consolidated_definition: Expresa el empeño o firmeza con que se pretende lograr un propósito o realizar una acción. “Dalia estaba decidida a entrar en el apartamento de D. Danilo a como diera lugar.” Ana Lydia Vega, Pasión de historia, p. 75.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Dedication refers to the determination or firmness with which a purpose is intended to be achieved or an action carried out. "Dalia was determined to enter Danilo's apartment at all costs."
